intro: Even after losing his head to the boiling brew at Grom'gol Base Camp, the Bloodscalp chieftain Gan'zulah seethes with fury. To appease his lingering rage, the severed spirit demands the death of his bitter Skullsplitter rivals and the ruin of their ruler, Ana'thek the Cruel.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Curse you! And curse your ancestors!!
Only blood and revenge can cool my rage, so if that is your wish, then... Do this:

Throw yourself into the heart of the Skullsplitters to the east. Slay the fiercest among them, and if you survive...then break yourself against their chief, Ana'thek the Cruel. Hah! Bring me his shattered armor if you can!
May he tear off your limbs and leave you to rot and be eaten by carrion.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Although my own flesh boils off my skull, I can still smell your fear.
Hah! You will never complete my task...

clips.title: Completion
paras: I do not want to believe it, but I cannot deny what you have done. And my rage eases, now that Ana'thek is defeated.
Your might will drive you to great deeds, friend. But one day...I will see you in the Nether and we will again match strength.
